about: The Kestrel's own sounds. The voice ("Autocraft Kestrel", made with Voice Design, eleven_ttv_v3) is the gunship's pilot: a cocky, clipped young fighter jock with a smirk in his voice, mid-range and brighter than the Ranger, lower and drier than the Comet, on his cockpit radio; its lines go through comm.py like the others'. Ids match the game's sound names (sfx/<name>_<n>): vkestrel = reports in, kestreldeath = his cry as it is shot down (the blast plays with it), rockets = one volley from the twin rocket pods (every 1.25 s, heard where the Kestrel flies), kestrelmove = a driven Kestrel's engines as it pulls away (at most every 2 s, in your ear).

entries.text: [cocky, clipped] Kestrel on station. Who needs a haircut?
[confident, quick] Wheels up. Point me at something.
[cocky, drawling] Relax. The cavalry flies now.
[short sharp cry] I'm hit, I'm hit!

entries.prompt: gunship rocket pods fire a volley, loud fiery whoosh of two rockets launching in quick succession and roaring away, crackling rocket exhaust, close up
salvo of small air-to-ground rockets launching from a helicopter's pods, rapid fizzing whooshes and a crackle of rocket motors streaking off, close up
two unguided rockets fired in quick succession, loud whoosh-whoosh of rocket motors igniting and screaming away, smoky hiss, close up
light attack gunship throttles up and pulls away: twin jet turbines spool up with a rising whine and a punchy rush of thrust, heard from the cockpit
agile VTOL fighter banks and accelerates hard: jet engines roar up, high turbine scream rising in pitch, rushing wind, from inside the cockpit
sci-fi gunship kicks in its thrusters and surges forward: sharp jet whine climbing fast, deep thrust rumble, air rushing past the canopy
